newsitem.title: USA: Food Lion jury says it is deadlocked.
newsitem.headline: Food Lion jury says it is deadlocked.

text.p: A jury considering punitive damages in Food Lion Inc's lawsuit against the ABC television network and four of its producers sent a second note to the judge late Wednesday saying the panel appeared to be deadlocked.
The note said the 12-member jury reached a stalemate because one juror, a woman, was determined not to work with the rest of the panel.
"Judge Tilley, we are truly stuck on further deliberations with the refusal of one juror to take their individual opinion and work collectively with the other jurors," the note said.

"I've tried to help her understand your instructions exactly how they were read. However, determination on her part not to work with us is actually caused a stalemate that would not otherwise exist. Please advise," it continued.

A jury hearing the case in U.S. District Court in Greensboro found last month that ABC, a unit of Walt Disney Co, committed fraud when two producers went to work undercover at a Food Lion store. It awarded the grocery chain $1,400 in compensatory damages.
